sets.title: Quick Quiz
sets.description: Choose between reflexive and non-reflexive verb forms
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите между возвратной и невозвратной формой глагола

items.promptEnglish: Dad dresses his son for school.
items.hint: He dresses someone else, not himself.
items.explanation: Одевает (no -ся) = dresses someone else. Одевается = dresses himself.
Называется (reflexive) = is called. Without -ся it would mean 'calls/names someone.'

items.promptEnglish: The children wake up early in the morning.
items.explanation: Дети = they, so use 3rd person plural: просыпаются.

items.promptEnglish: She looks at herself in the mirror every morning.
items.explanation: Смотрится (reflexive) = looks at herself. Смотрит (no -ся) = looks at something.

minimalPairs.explanation: Моет (no -ся) = washes something (hands). Моется would mean 'washes himself.'

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The girl washes herself before breakfast.
minimalPairs.explanation: Умывается (reflexive) = washes herself. Умывает would need an object.
Учим (no -ся) + object = we study/learn something specific. Учимся = we study (in general, no object).
Учимся (reflexive) = we study (at a place, no direct object). Учим requires a direct object.

sets.title: Fill and Sort
sets.description: Conjugate reflexive verbs and sort -ся vs -сь endings
sets.descriptionRussian: Спрягайте возвратные глаголы и рассортируйте окончания -ся и -сь

fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Conjugating reflexive verbs for different persons.
explanations: Я просыпаюсь: -сь after the vowel ю.
Он одевается: -ся after the consonant т.
Ты умываешься: -ся after the consonant ш.
Они учатся: -ся after the consonant т.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort: does this form end in -ся or -сь?

explanations: Ты одеваешься: -ся after the consonant ш.
Мы одеваемся: -ся after the consonant м.
Вы одеваетесь: -сь after the vowel е.

sets.title: Spot the Errors
sets.description: Find and fix -ся/-сь errors in reflexive verbs
sets.descriptionRussian: Найдите и исправьте ошибки -ся/-сь в возвратных глаголах

errorCorrection.hint: After a vowel ending, use -сь not -ся.
errorCorrection.explanation: Учите ends in vowel е, so add -сь: учитесь (not учитеся).

errorCorrection.hint: After a vowel ending, use -сь not -ся.
errorCorrection.explanation: Просыпаю ends in vowel ю, so add -сь: просыпаюсь (not просыпаюся).

errorCorrection.hint: After a consonant, use -ся. And no soft sign before -ся in 3rd person.
errorCorrection.explanation: Они учатся: no soft sign in 3rd person plural, and -ся after the consonant т.
Одеваешь ends in consonant ш (the ь is a soft sign, not a vowel), so add -ся: одеваешься.

items.promptEnglish: The cat warms itself in the sun.
items.explanation: Греется (reflexive) = warms itself. Греет would mean 'warms something else.'

items.promptEnglish: Mom is busy in the kitchen. (to be occupied)
items.explanation: Заниматься (reflexive) = to be busy/occupied. Она занимается.

items.hint: Я form: after vowel ю, use -сь.
items.explanation: Я умываюсь: -сь after the vowel ю. Not -ся.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: A mixed challenge covering reflexive verb meanings, forms, and conjugation
sets.descriptionRussian: Смешанное задание по значениям, формам и спряжению возвратных глаголов

patternRecognition.question: Why do these forms all end in -сь (not -ся)?
options: They are all я forms, which end in a vowel before the suffix
patternRecognition.answer: They are all я forms, which end in a vowel before the suffix
patternRecognition.explanation: All я forms end in a vowel (ю or у), so the reflexive suffix is -сь: умываюсь, учусь.

patternRecognition.question: What does -ся change about the meaning?
options: It makes the action reflect back on the subject (oneself)
patternRecognition.answer: It makes the action reflect back on the subject (oneself)
patternRecognition.explanation: Одевает ребёнка = dresses the child. Одевается = dresses himself/herself. The -ся makes the action reflexive.

patternRecognition.question: What is special about these reflexive verbs?
options: They are always reflexive and have no non-reflexive form
They are only used in past tense
patternRecognition.answer: They are always reflexive and have no non-reflexive form
patternRecognition.explanation: Some verbs like улыбаться (to smile), нравиться (to please/like), and называться (to be called) are always reflexive.

translation.hint: children = дети, wake up = просыпаются, early = рано
she = она, always = всегда, smiles = улыбается
we study = мы учимся, at university = в университете

minimalPairs.explanation: Одевает (no -ся) = dresses someone else (внучку). Одевается = dresses herself.
Бреется (reflexive) = shaves himself. Бреет would need an object (shaves someone else).
Учатся (reflexive) = they learn/study. Учат + object = they teach something.
